title: Databyss is now a desktop app!
body:
We have retired the web-based version of Databyss and encourage you to move to the desktop app. You should have received an email with links to download your data and instructions for moving to the desktop app.

Didn't receive the email? Don't worry, your data hasn't been deleted! Contact us through a channel linked below and we'll help you find it.

Your data will continue to be available from the links in the email for at least one year.

Questions or concerns? Email us or chat with us on Discord.
